_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqvault-vectors.mjs (src/pqvault.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqvault/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-pqvault.md (§5.2–§5.4, §5.15, §6) and docs/contracts/pqvault.md. UNAUDITED. The records (spec §5.2, §5.3, §5.4, §5.15). domains.V: DS_V = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256(type), keccak256("SCaaS PqVault"), keccak256("1"), salt = appId)) (mode 0); domains.B: DS_B = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256(type), keccak256("SCaaS PqVault"), keccak256("1"), uint256 chainId, address verifyingContract)) (mode 1, the instance B). purpose: appId = keccak256("scaas.pqvault.v1"), purpose P_V = appPurpose(appId) = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256("scaas.ua.purpose.app.v1"), appId)). Each vault row: its mode and home, then its records, each with typed = keccak256(0x1901 ‖ DS ‖ hashStruct) in its vault's domain, uaMessage.digest = uaMessage(kind, P_V, typed), a real signature (pq.js signUA, deterministic) as a UASig (keyData and members empty), sigHash = keccak256(abi.encode(UASig)); blob: group records abi.encode(record, UASig), an item abi.encode(item, sigHash, bytes32 0), an edit abi.encode(edit, sigHash); a batch: itemIds, header = abi.encode(vaultId, epochId, author, uint64 nonce, bytes32[] itemIds, sigHash), itemBlobs = abi.encode(item, batch sigHash, batchId). Ids: vaultId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag vault, creator, uint64 nonce, uint8 mode, homeChain, address homeVaultContract)) (epoch 0's id); epochId, itemId, batchId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag, vaultId, author, uint64 nonce)). Scopes: vault (creator); epoch (vaultId, author or member or admin): rekeys, leaves, removals; item (vaultId, author): items, edits, batches. The wraps and sealedInfo bytes are keys.json's, the ciphertexts items.json's. pqvAccount: PQV_ACCOUNT, a 24-word BIP-39 mnemonic (entropy rnd("pqv-account/entropy")), its seed (empty BIP-39 passphrase), xi = pq.js pqSeed(seed, "fndsa512", account, index) (ua-rs derive.rs ua_secret), the FN-DSA-512 key and UA: index 0 is the index vault's UA, index 1 a personal vault's. modes: the two vaultIds of one creator and nonce differ by mode; flipped: a create record with its mode changed after signing, its typed digest in the new mode's domain differs from the signed one; otherInstance: a mode-1 record's typed digest at another instance differs (its create refused PqVaultShape there by the home check). nativeMember: an EVM key holding a seat of the msig `msig`; mode 0 it signs the typed digest itself (ECDSA, RFC 6979, low-s, r ‖ s ‖ v, v 27/28); mode 1 it signs uaAuthDigest(registryDomain, its native id, purposeTag(member), memberDigest(msig, uaMessage(0x0120, P_V, typed))); each signature presented in the other mode recovers another address.
